items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Donald Harrison is made by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: And how about Harry Connick Jr.? Look at how colorful his career’s been.

Exactly. You just, you can’t tell. And then even Donald as he gave me this smooth jazz album, we talked about how he played because Kidd was his teacher, how for a period of time he only wanted to play avante garde. You know, now people don’t know that and even the music that he records now you would have to dig way back to find an avante garde album of Donald Harrison if it really exists, and I didn’t know he had played avante garde but he did. He says, “Oh for a minute I was mad too when I played that.”
